items.title: Gentle care for anxious dogs
items.text: Pet owners value how patiently the salon handles four-legged guests, particularly rescue pets or dogs with nervousness and anxiety. Reviewers emphasize that animals are treated with affection and warmth, allowing even timid companions to feel secure throughout their grooming appointments.
